fingerprint: A Makefile is successfully loaded and its recipe starts, but relative inputs or mkdir outputs resolve below the LocalFlow runtime root instead of the intended external project.
owner: accepted task working-directory snapshot and make invocation semantics
earliest_stage: normal user configuration expansion and plan output before enqueue

failure_baseline.artifact: current cef4941 product exercised through the normal run API with an external Makefile and relative prerequisite/output
failure_baseline.expected: naturally reproduce the reported LocalFlow-root path or keep the product owner frozen if the normal entry cannot reproduce it

success_baseline.artifact: explicit external working_directory with plain make, plus GNU make -C external-project
success_baseline.expected: CURDIR and all relative read/write side effects stay under the external project and no marker appears under LocalFlow root

steps: Capture plan snapshot, task snapshot, lifecycle cwd line, GNU make entering-directory output and filesystem effects from one run ID
Compare plain make in explicit cwd, make -C, and make -f without inferring intent from the command string
Locate the earliest divergence among configuration resolution, task persistence, executor cwd, Make CURDIR and recipe child cwd
Change only the proven owner, then rerun subprocess, systemd, frozen and public-release long chains
hard_gates: a normal product entry naturally reproduces every claimed failure baseline
plan working_directory equals immutable task snapshot and lifecycle cwd
Make CURDIR, recipe child pwd, prerequisite lookup and mkdir output agree
target marker exists and same-name LocalFlow-root marker is absent
a makefile selected with -f is not falsely described as changing cwd
current and deliberately mutated cwd implementations receive opposite verdicts
rollback: Do not modify executor or plugin cwd behavior until the normal entry reproduces a divergence; on failure return to the earliest observable owner.
exit_criteria: known failure rejection and known success acceptance are both 100 percent
current implementation passes two consecutive comparable Make long-chain runs
Hosted Ubuntu systemd and extracted frozen release both pass
user-root and project Skill rules are updated without claiming that Makefile location implies cwd
known_issue_regressions: verification plugin appends guessed make flags
executor receives LocalFlow root despite an external resolved working_directory
make -f external/Makefile is mistaken for make -C external
test checks printed PWD but not prerequisite lookup and positive/negative filesystem effects
